receipts.first_text_witness: You are at a closing table and the loan officer slides a sheet across to you. $400,000 house, $80,000 down, which took you 6 years, $320,000 borrowed. And the number at the bottom, the one you pay every month for 30 years, says $2,129. Your sister Pria bought the same floor plan two streets over in 2021. Same price, same down payment, same loan. Her payment is $1,349, $780 a month between you and your own sister for the same house. Nothing about that house changed. What changed was a decimal point on a government web page neither of you has ever looked at.
receipts.last_text_witness: It is not free anymore. Nobody sent you a notice. The rate changed and everything built on top of it, including the number on the sheet in front of you, changed with it. You are not bad with money. The price of money moved while you were living your life. So find out what your rate actually is and then make sure that everything you own is earning more than
